character_profiles.name: Spark
character_profiles.build: Clunky, boxy yet rounded retro-futuristic robot frame
character_profiles.face_details: Large, expressive circular glowing blue LED eyes on a metallic faceplate, capable of displaying simple digital emotions
character_profiles.outfit: Exposed brass and copper plating with visible joints, gears, and a vintage wind-up key on its back
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: Scuffed metallic textures, visible spinning gears at the elbow and knee joints, warm golden rim-lighting on its brass body
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A character concept of Spark, a charmingly clunky retro-futuristic robot made of polished brass and weathered copper plates. Spark has large, expressive glowing light-blue LED eyes on a rounded metallic head and visible gears at its joints. Its body is slightly boxy with a friendly, semi-stylized design. The lighting is warm and cinematic, highlighting the metallic textures and soft reflections. Pixar style, 3D animated, detailed textures, clean studio background.

character_profiles.name: Nova
character_profiles.build: Athletic, slender, and highly agile dancer's physique
character_profiles.face_details: Warm and expressive brown eyes, a wide welcoming smile, and friendly, soft facial features with realistic skin textures
character_profiles.hair: Dark brown hair styled in an asymmetrical undercut with vibrant neon-pink and electric-blue streaks
character_profiles.outfit: Modern streetwear consisting of a loose-fitting cropped holographic jacket, a dark athletic tank top, high-waisted jogger pants, and glowing neon sneakers
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: Neon-streaked hair, bright welcoming smile, and glowing accents on her sneakers that cast soft light
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A character concept of Nova, an energetic young adult female dancer. She has warm brown eyes, a welcoming bright smile, and dark hair with vibrant neon-pink and electric-blue streaks in a stylish undercut. She wears a modern holographic cropped jacket, a dark tank top, stylish jogger pants, and glowing neon sneakers. She has an athletic build and an expressive pose. Warm, realistic lighting with a colorful rim light. Pixar style, 3D animated, semi-stylized, clean studio background.
